summary: Iteration 8 — Frontend-only verification of Clube da Barrica, Pontos, and Analytics/Acessos UI (backend already 22/22 green). ALL 6 requested flows PASSED: (1) Register + Club opt-in on /login: switch-register works, club-join-block present, club-join-checkbox toggles club-join-fields (rendered only when checked). Defaults verified: optin-email=false, optin-whatsapp=false, accept-terms=false, accept-privacy=false. Submit without accepting terms/privacy is blocked (native `required={club.join}` HTML validation keeps the user on /login — form never posts). Submit with both accepts + optin-whatsapp checked returned JWT (adega_token len=155), redirected to /conta with toast 'Bem-vindo à Casa da Barrica Wines'. (2) /conta 'Clube & Pontos' tab: account-tab-clube switches to club-tab. points-balance shows '0 pontos', points-summary text confirms rule '1 ponto a cada R$ 5 em produtos (frete não conta)' and 'Resgate: em breve'. club-status shows 'Membro desde 15/09/2026 · Termos de Adesão v1.0'. points-history shows 'Nenhum movimento ainda.' Editing club-form-phone='11988887777' + checking club-form-optin-email + clicking club-save-btn persists after page reload (PATCH /api/account/club worked). (3) Cart /carrinho (path is /catalogo not /vinhos): adding Alma Negra Misterio to cart, filling CEP 01310-100 + birthdate: cart-points-earn renders 'Uma compra real aprovada renderia 27 pontos do Clube (pedidos em demonstração não geram pontos)' — floor(135/5)=27 correct, shipping excluded. redeem-points input is ABSENT (redeem disabled state respected). sales-suspended-banner visible with correct text, cart-checkout-btn is disabled. (4) Admin /admin Acessos tab (session injected in mongosh with role=owner, mfa_enabled=true, token placed in localStorage.adega_token): admin-tab-acessos loads analytics-panel with all cards populated (an-sessions=6, an-pageviews=32, an-cart=1, an-checkouts=0, an-purchases=0, an-revenue=R$0,00), an-funnel with 4 conversion rates + '30 dias' label, an-signups=4 as separate indicator, an-top-wines lists 'Alma Negra Misterio 1', an-top-pages lists /login, /conta, /carrinho, /catalogo, /vinho/…, an-privacy-note begins 'Sem IP, fingerprint ou cookies persistentes… Retenção: 180 dias'. (5) Period selectors analytics-days-7/30/90 all present and functional — switching to 90d re-fetches data (funnel label flips to '(90 dias)'). (6) Tracking e2e verified organically: /catalogo and /vinho/wine_96a27b4fc9 appeared in top-pages after client browsing, and Alma Negra Misterio appeared in top-wines with 1 view. (7) Config → points-config section is READ-ONLY inspection: earn_enabled=true, redeem_enabled=false, point_value_brl=0, max_redeem_percent=50, reais_per_point=5 — matches spec, no save action performed. Cleanup executed: deleteMany /^teste\.cliente\./ (4 users), /^teste\.admin\./ (1 user), user_sessions /^test_(session|adm_session)/ (1 session). Store settings untouched (sales still suspended, payment_mode demo, redeem still disabled).

issues: Value '0 pontos' renders in Bodoni-style serif so a screenshot skim reads 'o pontos'. Text is correct in DOM but visually the leading zero looks like a lowercase 'o'. Consider tabular-nums or slightly heavier weight for the counter.

critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.jsx (line 180/184): using `required={club.join}` on the terms/privacy checkboxes is a nice UX guardrail, but it blocks the form via native HTML validation before the toast/backend even sees the payload — the review spec asked for a 'toast/erro 400'. Consider replacing native `required` with an explicit toast.error(...) before calling register() so the user gets a Portuguese message ('É preciso aceitar os Termos e a Política de Privacidade para entrar no Clube'). The 400 path is exercised only by backend tests, not by this UI.

CartPage.jsx cart-points-earn (line ~151): the sentence 'Uma compra real aprovada renderia 27 pontos do Clube (pedidos em demonstração não geram pontos)' is only visible after a quote is returned — if the CEP is invalid or the customer hasn't filled it yet, the block silently hides. Consider a small 'informe seu CEP para ver a estimativa de pontos' hint so the empty state is not confused with 'no points earned'.

AdminPage.jsx analytics: an-top-pages includes internal paths such as /admin, /catalogo/2, /vinho/<id>. Grouping /vinho/* as a single row (or aggregating pagination like /catalogo/N → /catalogo) would make the top-pages panel more useful without breaking privacy. Optional.

AdminPage.jsx points-config (line 681): read-only badges for the current state are absent. When redeem_enabled=false and point_value_brl=0, the owner sees an unchecked checkbox and a zero input with no explanation. A short caption like 'Resgate desativado — defina o valor do ponto antes de ativar' would prevent accidental activation with value=0.
test_credentials: Ephemeral only: three throwaway customer emails teste.cliente.<ts>@example.com (registered via UI and deleted) + one injected owner session test_adm_session_1789484810180 (deleted). Owner mgrodrigues920@gmail.com was NOT touched.
seed_data_creation: One admin doc {role:'owner', mfa_enabled:true} + session inserted via mongosh (per /app/auth_testing.md), then removed. Three customer users created through /auth/register UI, then removed. No wines, orders, coupons, secrets or store_settings mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend route for the wines catalog is /catalogo (not /vinhos as the review request said — /vinhos is unrouted and tracked as an analytics pageview but 404s). Add-to-cart is done on the wine detail page via a button labeled 'Adicionar ao carrinho' (no dedicated data-testid; btn-buy-now is a separate flow). To inject an admin session for UI tests: (a) mongosh insert user with role='owner' + mfa_enabled=true and a user_sessions doc, (b) set localStorage.adega_token=<session_token> on the origin, then navigate to /admin — the token is passed by /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js as Authorization: Bearer. Analytics panel tolerates empty top_wines/top_pages gracefully. Points config in Config tab renders read-only fields via checkbox/inputs — DO NOT click settings-save-btn in Config while validating.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found; this iteration is a feature verification.
